name: AutoSteer
description: Publishes fused-pose guidance commands, AB line tracking, and actuator transport for production rigs.

defaultMode.description: Default steering controller engaged when the plugin starts.

poseTimeoutSeconds.description: Time without fused pose updates before the controller disengages.

engageHoldSeconds.description: Duration the operator switch must be held before AutoSteer engages.

maxSteerAngleDegrees.description: Maximum steer command applied to the actuator.

simProviders.description: Publishes fused GNSS/IMU pose samples with deterministic latency for controller validation.
Generates steering commands from AB lines using fused pose input.
Exercises CAN/serial actuator transport for bench validation and diagnostics.
